title.zh: Claude Fable 5.2发布：提速与分级访问
title.en: Claude Fable 5.2: Faster Output, Tiered Access

excerpt.zh: Claude Fable 5.2与Mythos 5.2共用底层模型，主打复杂技术任务，并降低价格、提升输出速度。两者的安全防护与访问方式不同，官方测试结果仍需结合评测条件和实际任务判断。
excerpt.en: Claude Fable 5.2 brings faster output and lower prices. Mythos shares its underlying model, with access subject to approval.

text.zh: Fable与Mythos：同一模型，不同访问方式
text.en: Fable and Mythos: Shared Model, Different Access

text.zh: Anthropic于2026年11月9日发布Claude Fable 5.2与Claude Mythos 5.2，称其编程、推理和视觉能力有所提升。两者共用底层模型：Fable配置网络安全与生物领域防护，面向所有用户；从事有益网络安全或生物医学研究的机构，可通过验证项目申请Mythos访问权限。
text.en: Anthropic announced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 on November 9, 2026, reporting improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision. They share an underlying model. Fable includes cybersecurity and biology safeguards for availability to all users; organizations pursuing beneficial cybersecurity or biomedical research can apply for Mythos access through verification programs.

text.zh: 据官方介绍，两款模型的输出速度较5.1版最高提升30%，标准价格降至每百万输入token 8美元、输出token 40美元。可选快速模式的token生成速度最高为常规模式的2.5倍，输入与输出价格也分别翻倍至16美元和80美元。生成提速并不意味着整个任务会按同样比例缩短。
text.en: According to Anthropic, output is up to 30% faster than the 5.1 versions, with lower standard prices of $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. Optional fast mode offers up to 2.5 times the token generation speed, at doubled prices of $16 and $80 respectively. Faster generation does not imply an equivalent reduction in total task time.

text.zh: 官方报告Fable 5.2在FrontierCode 2.0上取得49.1%的成绩，高于Fable 5.1的32.4%；另称其在较低计算投入下，可用约一半的单任务成本接近Opus 5.5的最佳成绩。这显示复杂任务的成本效率可能改善，但Anthropic仍建议多数编程和知识任务先使用Opus 5.5，再按难度升级。
text.en: Anthropic reports a FrontierCode 2.0 score of 49.1% for Fable 5.2, versus 32.4% for Fable 5.1. It also says a lower effort setting approaches Opus 5.5’s best score at roughly half the cost per task. That suggests potential efficiency gains on difficult work, although the company still recommends starting most coding and knowledge tasks with Opus 5.5.

text.zh: 官方评测仍需现实任务验证
这些结果来自厂商公布的测试与案例。不同评测采用的计算投入、防护设置和任务并不完全一致，其中网络安全评测甚至使用各实验室各自的任务，限制了直接横向比较。Anthropic称安全测试总体表现良好，但所给节选未提供独立验证。关键问题是：这些提升能否在用户自己的工作流中稳定转化为可靠结果与更低总成本。
text.en: These results come from vendor-reported tests and examples. Effort levels, safeguards, and tasks vary across evaluations; one cybersecurity benchmark even uses different tasks for each laboratory, limiting direct comparisons. Anthropic reports generally favorable safety testing, but the supplied excerpt provides no independent validation. The central question is whether these gains consistently translate into reliable results and lower total costs in users’ own workflows.
